messages:
From: Lisa Tran <lisa.tran@novapath.co>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: accounts@novapath.co
Date: 2026-01-18T10:12:00-08:00
Subject: NovaPath onboarding docs — W-9 attached

Hi Irene,

Thanks for the quick intro yesterday. Per our onboarding checklist, please find our completed W-9 attached. Our legal name and EIN are on the form — let me know if you need these in a particular format for your vendor portal.

Attachment: W-9_NovaPath_signed.pdf (PDF, signed)

A couple of notes: we bill monthly, net 30. If you need any additional verification (bank letter, certificate of good standing) we can provide — would prefer to avoid notarization if possible due to our remote org.

Best,
Lisa Tran
Accounts Payable Manager
NovaPath Solutions
Phone: +1 415-555-0198
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Tran <lisa.tran@novapath.co>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-01-18T14:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: NovaPath onboarding docs — W-9 attached

Hi Lisa,

Thanks — I received the W-9. Quick next steps from our side:
- Finance needs either a bank letter (bank-issued) or an extract of your state business registration to confirm the EIN/legal name match.
- Ben (vendor onboarding) will open the vendor record; we typically also request a short KYB form (link below) for our procurement due diligence.
- Once verification is complete, we create a PO and share the PO number + DocuSign for signed supplier terms.

Ben — can you kick off vendor setup once Naomi gives the green light on the docs?

Lisa — if a bank letter is easiest, please send it back in reply. If you can’t notarize, we can accept a bank-issued letter with bank contact info.

KYB form: https://forms.gle/kyb-novapath

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Sr. Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Lisa Tran <lisa.tran@novapath.co>
Date: 2026-01-19T09:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: NovaPath onboarding docs — W-9 attached

Irene / Ben / Lisa —

Quick checklist from finance to expedite PO:
1) Confirmed W-9 with EIN (received).
2) Secondary verification: bank letter OR state filing (certificate of good standing). Bank letter is preferred — should show legal name + account holder info.
3) W-9 name must match the name used on invoices or we’ll have to route for manual review.

If Lisa can provide a bank letter, we can approve vendor record within 1–2 business days and issue PO. Otherwise, state filing may take longer.

Ben: please prepare the PO draft and set it to pending — I’ll move to approved after I validate attachments.

Thanks — Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Director, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Lisa Tran <lisa.tran@novapath.co>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-01-20T11:08:00-08:00
Subject: Re: NovaPath onboarding docs — W-9 attached

Hi all,

Attaching a bank letter from First Harbor confirming NovaPath Solutions as account holder. Our legal name and EIN are printed on the W-9 we sent; the bank letter shows our business name and has a bank verifier listed if you need to call. We do not have notarization capability for this document.

Attachment: BankLetter_NovaPath_20260120.pdf (PDF, bank-issued)

If there’s anything else required to match your internal fields (company name formatting, DBA notes), tell me and I’ll get it corrected.

Thanks,
Lisa
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Tran <lisa.tran@novapath.co>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-01-23T16:40:00-08:00
Subject: NovaPath onboarding: tax certification and PO creation

Lisa —

Thanks for the bank letter — Naomi has validated the documents and we’ve moved forward with vendor activation.

Status:
- Vendor record created and approved.
- PO created: PO-45321 (attached/internal link).
- DocuSign envelope for supplier terms sent to the email on file — please complete the signature to finalize the supplier agreement.

Expected next actions:
1) Sign DocuSign (link: https://docusign.com/0a1b2c).
2) Once signed, Redwood will accept first invoice against PO-45321.

If anything changes on your billing cadence or legal name, notify Ben and Naomi so we don’t need to reissue the PO.

Thanks again and welcome aboard.

Best,
Irene Choi
Sr. Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

[Internal note: PO document stored at https://redwood.internal/po/PO-45321]
